title: geogen quests v1
description: The `quests` section of a manifest or chunk index: every quest of the package, and the rules that run them. A quest has no logic of its own: its progress is actor state (declared in the `state` section) moved by `rules`, which are rules of a geogen-rules program (docs/rules.md). The rest is what a quest log, tracker or marker needs to show it. Design: docs/quests.md.

rules.description: The compiled rules, in program order, ids 'quest:<quest>:<available | unavailable | start | fail | rewards | objective id>'. Every `set` is conditional on the state it expects.

holder.description: The kind of actor that can hold it.

start.description: given: a start effect starts it. auto: it starts as soon as it is available.

status.description: The variable holding its lifecycle state: unavailable | available | active | complete | failed.

available.description: It is unavailable while this is false.

fail.description: It fails when this becomes true while active.

optional.description: Not needed for the quest to complete.

after.description: Objectives that must be done first. It is open while the quest is active, these are done and it is not.

key.description: How many times its event has happened, a number.

progress.description: For 'n of m' displays: `value` evaluated for the actor, out of `of`.

subjects.description: Stable IDs of what it is about (a place, the things its condition reads): where markers go.

area.description: Mark a ring of this radius (m), not the exact spot.

on.description: The event that triggers it; without one, `when` is watched.
